profile.headline: Software Engineer - Hardware Test at Zipline
profile.summary: I love product development and entrepreneurship. Discovering the newest best product or process occupies much of my free time. I also enjoy playing soccer, surfing, camping, and playing music.

positions.title: Software Engineer - Hardware Test
positions.locationName: South San Francisco, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Senior Research And Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Wrote requirements and FMEA for V&V testing of a class III medical device for FDA pre-market approval
• Coded product lifetime tests and analysis using MATLAB/python and raspberry pi with Ubuntu OS
• Designed fixtures and assemblies using Solidworks CAD to test, analyze, and improve products
• Wrote and updated eng docs including test protocols, test reports, SOPs, FMEAs, MPIs, DMRs for V&V
• Ensured compliance with ISO 14708, IEC 60601-1, ISO 11607-1, ASTM D4332, ASTM D4169, ASTM F1980
positions.insights: Skills: Medical Devices · SOLIDWORKS · Python (Programming Language) · Laboratory Automation · MATLAB

positions.title: Senior Systems Integration Engineer
positions.description:
• Using Solidworks, designed custom injection molded, machined, 3D printed, Urethane casted parts
• Created BOMs and 2D Solidworks drawings with dimensions and tolerances to send to vendors
• Maintained 3D CAD product model in Solidworks with over 3000 parts, each with part #s and vendors

positions.title: Senior Engineering Research Associate
positions.locationName: San Carlos, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Stealth mode startup in the proteomics space trying to disrupt mass spectrometry market

• Wrote first set of user needs and eng requirements for flow cell and optical protein seq robot system
• Coded algorithms in python that integrated microscope, camera, fluidic system and X-Y stage
• Prototyped and designed consumable flow cell using Solidworks considering high-throughput DFM
positions.insights: Skills: SOLIDWORKS · Laboratory Automation · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Systems Engineer II
positions.description:
•	Designed and improved automated sensor feedback loops for on-chip assays
•	Researched and developed microfluidic flow sensor to work with custom reagents for assay
•	Wrote TRQs, PRQs, and FMEAs along with their relevant test cases as the ‘subject matter expert’

positions.title: System Engineer I
positions.description:
•	Systems Integration of multiple technologies: LVDS, SMEM, FPGA, IC, GPUs, RNN, Microfluidics, Automated Gantry Robot, Python SW Stack, Java/C++ SW Stack, RabbitMQ, PCR Proteins 
•	Developed software stack and designed hardware for automated pipette robot 
•	Improved microfluidic processes with inline pressure sensor and software control loop
•	Diagrammed system architecture with Lucidchart and Visual Paradigm for software team

positions.title: Scientist I, Sequencing
positions.description:
•	Developed python scripts to diagnose and improve microfluidic and bioelectric processes
•	Designed python software for microfluidics including Tecan, Hamilton, Kloehn, Sensirion, Idex
•	Analyzed flow patterns in syringe pump hardware to increase accuracy and yield 
•	Helped analyze electrical signal to improve system state readings and actuation of electrodes

positions.title: Study Session Leader
positions.locationName: San Luis Obispo County, California, United States
positions.description:
•	Subjects include Calculus 1,2,3 & 4 and General Chemistry 1,2 & 3
•	Demands strong leadership and communication skills to teach students effectively 
•	Requires intimate knowledge of subjects to explain concepts to students

company.name: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Automated a 5kW portable solar array to track the sun and store energy into batteries
•	Programmed a BeagleBone microcontroller using C in a Linux environment 
•	Designed and implemented hydraulic and electrical system to work with microcontroller

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Researched synthesized chemicals with biocidal applications so that their properties could be understood and their killing optimized. 
•	Presented research each week to group of professors and graduate students.
•	Research published in Langmuir: ACS Journal of Surfactants and Colloids.

honors.title: Innovation Quest Finalist
honors.issuer: Issued by Cal Poly Center for Innovation and Entrepreneurship · May 2015

projects.title: Pomfrey Medical
projects.description: I am leading a team of engineers and business peopel in making a website service for people with chronic diseases. We have already conducted many interviews for market and customer development. Currently we are working on our first MVPs and Prototypes of our website.

projects.title: BigFoot Crutch Startup
projects.description: I, along with another Cal Poly engineer, invented and manufactured 6 prototypes of a crutch that could also be used for physical therapy. I lead a team of 4 engineers and 2 business people in developing a business plan and marketing strategy. My team was a finalist in Innovation Quest, an entrepreneurship contest at Cal Poly. We presented our work to a group of investors and venture capitalists in the finals.
